principal_statement: Exact bivariate Pólya orbit-polynomial equation, sharp first arity discrepancy equal to one closure-overhead-one orbit at n=k+1, and complete overhead support and endpoint classifications.
scientific_limitations: OEIS A052300 already records unrestricted ungraded rooted-Greg-tree totals.
General Pólya multiset theory and the finite-meet-tree Fraisse results are pre-existing.
Exact independent coefficient comparisons only through six marked vertices.
An implicit or unindexed prior statement of the combined graded orbit theorem has not been ruled out.
scientific_scope: Unordered finite subsets of the Fraisse-generic meet-trees of all finite arities and unrestricted arity, in the language with binary meet; grading by size of the extra meet-closure.
title: Closure-overhead orbit polynomials and a sharp arity fingerprint for homogeneous meet-trees
